title: News and Events
text:
TipHow to set up the calendar (delete this box when done)






Open Google Calendar, click the gear icon, then Settings.
Under Settings for my calendars, pick the calendar (or create a new one named “American Beaver Party”).
Under Access permissions, check Make available to public.
Under Integrate calendar, copy the Calendar ID and paste it in place of YOUR_CALENDAR_ID%40group.calendar.google.com above (keep %40 in place of the @).
Change ctz= to your time zone, and change mode=AGENDA to MONTH or WEEK if you prefer.
